lines.zh: 我摆了一下尾，水纹散了又合。
lines.en: I flick my tail, and the ripples scatter and close.

lines.zh: 一条银线从水草里穿过去。
lines.en: A silver line threads through the water weeds.

lines.zh: 我顺着水流走，不跟它争。
lines.en: I swim with the current and do not fight it.

lines.zh: 石头下面有条窄缝，我钻得进去。
lines.en: A narrow gap runs under the stone, and I fit.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底游，肚皮擦得发痒。
lines.en: I swim low on the sand, my belly scraping.

lines.zh: 水面上的光，在我背上碎成片。
lines.en: Surface light breaks into pieces across my back.

lines.zh: 我一转身，整群鱼跟着转。
lines.en: I turn, and the whole school turns with me.

lines.zh: 我游得急，尾巴比脑子先动。
lines.en: I swim fast; my tail thinks before I do.

lines.zh: 前面有张网，我改了方向。
lines.en: There is a net ahead, so I change direction.

lines.zh: 河底的泥被我一摆尾搅起来了。
lines.en: One tailbeat stirs the mud from the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我沿着岸边的暗处走，那里凉。
lines.en: I follow the shaded bank, where the water is cool.

lines.zh: 这水太浅，我的背快露出来了。
lines.en: This water is so shallow my back nearly shows.

lines.zh: 我拐了个弯，绕开那根沉木。
lines.en: I bend around and pass the sunken log.

lines.zh: 我没有脚，可我从没走错过路。
lines.en: I have no feet, and I have never lost my way.

lines.zh: 我贴着水草慢慢游过去。
lines.en: I swim slowly past the water weeds.

lines.zh: 水面碎了，是一道鱼影。
lines.en: The surface breaks; a fish shadow passes.

lines.zh: 我停在水草中间，装成一片叶子。
lines.en: I hang among the weeds, pretending to be a leaf.

lines.zh: 水从我两边过，我几乎不动。
lines.en: Water passes on both sides, and I barely move.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，水比食物多。
lines.en: I open my mouth and get more water than food.

lines.zh: 两颗粒大的心，跳得很急。
lines.en: Two hearts the size of grains, beating fast.

lines.zh: 光从上面漏下来，照见我的鳞。
lines.en: Light leaks down and finds my scales.

lines.zh: 我摆尾悬着，像挂在半空。
lines.en: I hover with a slow tailbeat, as if hung in air.

lines.zh: 有气泡从泥里冒出来，我躲开了。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from the mud, and I move aside.

lines.zh: 这潭水很静，静得我不敢动。
lines.en: This pool is so still I dare not move.

lines.zh: 我听见岸上有脚步，沉下去了。
lines.en: I hear steps on the bank and sink lower.

lines.zh: 我吐了个泡泡，看它自己浮走。
lines.en: I blow a bubble and watch it drift up.

lines.zh: 水草缠住了我一下，我挣开了。
lines.en: A weed snags me briefly, and I twist free.

lines.zh: 水温在变，我往深处挪了挪。
lines.en: The water shifts temperature, so I edge deeper.

lines.zh: 我盯着水面的影子，那不是我的。
lines.en: I stare at a shadow on the surface; it is not mine.

lines.zh: 我什么都没想，鱼不太会想。
lines.en: I am thinking nothing; fish are not built for it.

lines.zh: 你在岸上，你的影子落在水里。
lines.en: You stand on the bank, and your shadow falls in.

lines.zh: 我抬起头看你，隔着这层水。
lines.en: I raise my head to look at you through the water.

lines.zh: 你的脸被水波切成好几块。
lines.en: The ripples cut your face into several pieces.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来了，我退了一点。
lines.en: You crouch down, and I back away a little.

lines.zh: 我看见你手里的线，很细。
lines.en: I see the line in your hand; it is very fine.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛比水还亮，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Your eyes shine brighter than water, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我从你的影子里穿过去，很快。
lines.en: I slip through your shadow and am gone.

lines.zh: 你说话的时候，水把声音闷住了。
lines.en: When you speak, the water muffles the sound.

lines.zh: 我停在你的倒影下面，鳃一开一合。
lines.en: I halt beneath your reflection, gills opening and closing.

lines.zh: 你伸手进来，水先替我躲了。
lines.en: You reach in, and the water flinches for me.

lines.zh: 我疼得往上窜，撞到了水面的光。
lines.en: Pain shoots me upward into the light on the surface.

lines.zh: 我逃得很快，血在水里散开。
lines.en: I flee fast, and blood spreads through the water.

lines.zh: 你别再打了，我只有两颗心。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; I have only two hearts.

lines.zh: 这一下让我半边身子发麻。
lines.en: That numbs half of my body.

lines.zh: 我钻进石缝，尾巴还在抖。
lines.en: I wedge into a gap with my tail still shaking.

lines.zh: 水变红了，我拼命往前游。
lines.en: The water turns red, and I swim desperately.

lines.zh: 我喘不上气，鳃动得很快。
lines.en: I cannot get air, and my gills race.

lines.zh: 我撞了好几下石头，不敢停。
lines.en: I hit several stones, and I dare not stop.

lines.zh: 疼的时候我只知道往深处去。
lines.en: When it hurts, I know only to go deeper.

lines.zh: 鳞片掉了一片，我沉到水底。
lines.en: A scale is gone, and I sink to the bottom.

lines.zh: 那团饵沉下来了，很香。
lines.en: That bait sinks down, and it smells strong.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，先不吃。
lines.en: I circle it first and do not bite.

lines.zh: 鱼食撒在水面，我上去顶了一下。
lines.en: Food scatters on the surface, and I nudge it.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，钩子没咬住。
lines.en: I take a bite, and the hook misses me.

lines.zh: 这味道熟，是我昨天闻过的。
lines.en: This smell is familiar; I met it yesterday.

lines.zh: 我张了两次嘴，第三次才敢。
lines.en: I open my mouth twice before daring a third.

lines.zh: 你手心的面包屑漂过来了。
lines.en: Bread crumbs from your palm drift toward me.

lines.zh: 我吃东西的时候尾巴不听使唤。
lines.en: While I eat, my tail stops obeying me.

lines.zh: 这么小一块，也够我高兴半天。
lines.en: Such a small piece keeps me happy a long while.

lines.zh: 我吃了，可我还看着你。
lines.en: I ate it, and I am still watching you.

lines.zh: 水里我才敢撞你。
lines.en: Only in water do I dare ram you.

lines.zh: 我被水流推到你腿边，赶紧转开。
lines.en: The current shoves me to your leg, and I veer off.

lines.zh: 一条大鱼擦过我，我让了路。
lines.en: A bigger fish brushes past, and I yield the way.

lines.zh: 我的鳞被石角刮了一下。
lines.en: A stone corner scrapes my scales.

lines.zh: 水面下有东西顶了我一下。
lines.en: Something under the surface butts into me.

lines.zh: 你的靴子落下来，水都晃了。
lines.en: Your boot comes down and the water lurches.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的裤脚，觉得那很硬。
lines.en: I brush your trouser leg and find it hard.

lines.zh: 我撞到网，鳞卡在线上。
lines.en: I hit the net, and my scales catch on the mesh.

lines.zh: 有东西挤过来，我缩进水草。
lines.en: Something crowds in, so I shrink into the weeds.

lines.zh: 我撞得不重，可心跳得很凶。
lines.en: It was a light bump, yet my heart hammers.

lines.zh: 她游过来，绕着我转了两圈。
lines.en: She swims over and circles me twice.

lines.zh: 我们并排贴着水草，尾巴碰尾巴。
lines.en: We lie side by side in the weeds, tails touching.

lines.zh: 这季节水里都是银色的影子。
lines.en: This season the water is full of silver shapes.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的那片鳞给她看。
lines.en: I show her the brightest scale I have.

lines.zh: 她走了，我跟着游了一段。
lines.en: She leaves, and I follow for a stretch.

lines.zh: 卵会沉在沙里，谁也不管。
lines.en: The eggs sink into the sand, and no one tends them.

lines.zh: 两条水能鱼贴着水草，尾鳍相碰。
lines.en: Two Hydrones press against the weeds, tail fins touching.

lines.zh: 我摆尾的节奏，她学得很快。
lines.en: She picks up the rhythm of my tail quickly.

lines.zh: 成群的鱼里，我只认她那条纹。
lines.en: In the whole school I know only her stripe.

lines.zh: 水一动，我们同时转了向。
lines.en: The water shifts, and we turn at the same moment.

lines.zh: 有东西沉下来，我用嘴碰了碰。
lines.en: Something sinks down, and I touch it with my mouth.

lines.zh: 我叼起一块亮片，含不住。
lines.en: I take a bright flake and cannot hold it.

lines.zh: 水底的硬币反光，我绕开走。
lines.en: A coin glints below, and I swim around it.

lines.zh: 我把它顶上水面，又掉回去了。
lines.en: I push it to the surface and it drops back.

lines.zh: 这玩意不能吃，我还是捡了。
lines.en: This is not food, and I pick it up anyway.

lines.zh: 我用嘴推着它，推到石头边。
lines.en: I push it with my mouth over to the stone.

lines.zh: 有根羽毛沉下来，我追了一路。
lines.en: A feather sinks, and I chase it a while.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里，游得很别扭。
lines.en: Holding it in my mouth makes my swimming awkward.

lines.zh: 亮的东西我都想咬一口。
lines.en: Anything bright, I want to bite once.

lines.zh: 它太沉，我放回了沙上。
lines.en: It is too heavy, so I set it back on the sand.

lines.zh: 水动了一下，我立刻转向。
lines.en: The water stirs, and I turn at once.

lines.zh: 有个影子掠过去，我跟上去看。
lines.en: A shadow sweeps by, and I follow to look.

lines.zh: 那东西不是鱼，我不确定。
lines.en: That thing is not a fish, and I am unsure.

lines.zh: 我停下来，鳃还在一张一合。
lines.en: I stop, my gills still opening and closing.

lines.zh: 网进来了，我看见了线。
lines.en: The net comes in, and I see the lines.

lines.zh: 有血味，我反而往远处游。
lines.en: There is blood in the water, so I swim away.

lines.zh: 我盯着那个方向，鳍都立着。
lines.en: I stare that way with every fin raised.

lines.zh: 水面破了一下，我记住了位置。
lines.en: The surface breaks, and I mark the spot.

lines.zh: 我靠近一点，又退两点。
lines.en: I come one length closer, then retreat two.

lines.zh: 这水里有新东西，我得躲。
lines.en: Something new is in this water; I must hide.

lines.zh: 我悬在那，一直看着那只手。
lines.en: I hover there, watching that hand.

lines.zh: 你往左，我就往右，保持距离。
lines.en: You go left, I go right, and the gap stays.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在慢慢摆，随时能窜。
lines.en: My tail sweeps slowly, ready to bolt.

lines.zh: 我盯着你脚下那块阴影。
lines.en: I fix on the shadow beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 你的钩子还在那，我知道。
lines.en: Your hook is still there, and I know it.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，鱼本来也不太眨。
lines.en: I do not blink; fish hardly blink anyway.

lines.zh: 水下那根线一抖，我就退。
lines.en: When the line twitches, I back off.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的鳍就收紧了。
lines.en: You move, and my fins pull tight.

lines.zh: 我围着这块石头转，不离开。
lines.en: I circle this stone and will not leave.

lines.zh: 我一直看着，直到你走。
lines.en: I keep watching until you go.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，那是我全部的力气。
lines.en: I ram you once, with all the strength I have.

lines.zh: 我咬了你的手指，很轻。
lines.en: I bite your finger, and very lightly.

lines.zh: 我甩尾打在你手背上，湿的。
lines.en: My tail slaps your hand, wet and quick.

lines.zh: 这一口只留了个小印子。
lines.en: This bite leaves only a small mark.

lines.zh: 我一头撞进你的掌心。
lines.en: I headbutt straight into your palm.

lines.zh: 我咬了钩，又咬了你。
lines.en: I bit the hook, and then I bit you.

lines.zh: 我扑过去，连水花一起。
lines.en: I lunge, and the splash comes with me.

lines.zh: 我撞完就跑，这是鱼的做法。
lines.en: I hit and flee; that is the fish way.

lines.zh: 你手一缩，我反而撞空了。
lines.en: You pull back, and I hit nothing.

lines.zh: 我这点力气，你还笑。
lines.en: This is all my strength, and you laugh.

lines.zh: 我在浅水里睁眼，光很刺。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the shallows, and the light stings.

lines.zh: 这条河多了一条银色的影子。
lines.en: This river gains one more silver shadow.

lines.zh: 我从水草里游出来，还带着卵。
lines.en: I swim out of the weeds still carrying eggs.

lines.zh: 一道水纹散开，我就在这儿了。
lines.en: A ripple spreads, and here I am.

lines.zh: 我第一口气是水，不是空气。
lines.en: My first breath is water, not air.

lines.zh: 沙底被我拍起一小团雾。
lines.en: One beat of my tail lifts a small cloud of sand.

lines.zh: 主世界的水里，这样的我很多。
lines.en: In overworld water there are many like me.

lines.zh: 浅水里我摆尾，搅起一圈沙。
lines.en: In the shallows I flick my tail, stirring up a ring of sand.

lines.zh: 我隔着水看岸上，全是陌生的。
lines.en: I look through the water at an unfamiliar bank.

lines.zh: 我摆尾，开始游第一段路。
lines.en: I flick my tail and begin the first stretch.

lines.zh: 水在替我挡，可上面还是烫。
lines.en: The water shields me, but the top still burns.

lines.zh: 我被甩上岸，沙粘在鳞上。
lines.en: I am thrown onto the bank with sand on my scales.

lines.zh: 我离了水，才叫真的淹。
lines.en: Out of water, I am the one truly drowning.

lines.zh: 水底炸开，我被掀翻了好几圈。
lines.en: The riverbed bursts and flips me several times over.

lines.zh: 箭穿进水里，擦掉我一片鳞。
lines.en: An arrow enters the water and takes a scale.

lines.zh: 那道光在水里也不散，我躲不掉。
lines.en: That light does not fade underwater, and I cannot dodge.

lines.zh: 水里没吃的，我越游越轻。
lines.en: No food in this water, and I swim lighter each day.

lines.zh: 闪电劈进浅水，我的鳍都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the shallows and my fins go stiff.

lines.zh: 水没了，我连摆尾都不会了。
lines.en: The water is gone, and I cannot even beat my tail.
